scope: One native presentation-owner transaction/immutable-effect component over real PostgreSQL and a native display pairing. Not HTTP/OIDC/SSE transport, production-image throughput or latency/load evidence.
actual_checks: Actual native owner reads current revision, creates scoped pairing and commits explicit override with exact cue hash/decision marker
Independent immutable native audit anchors the committed revision; paired native snapshot exposes the actual matching positive cue
A deliberately different later native override does not erase/change the original marker/hash/audit effect
fixture_boundaries: Synthetic fixture identities and event/owner assignment
No injected clock; native owner uses normal wall defaults
No application HTTP/OIDC or SSE delivery latency measured
No full burst, saturation or 1,800-second/1,000-active-person execution
